_comment: Maps each Paycheck8 'Jobcode/FY' code to how it should show up on the OF-288. Unrecognized jobcodes cause the tool to stop and ask, rather than guess. Copy this file to jobcode_rules.json (gitignored — it fills up with your own real work data) and edit it as new jobcodes show up on future paystubs.

WFSE0000.note: Example: a default/home-unit duty code, not incident time — excluded from the OF-288 entirely.

66.note: Example: a per-jobcode override for a specific trans code that needs different handling than the global trans_code_rules default.
